subject: Request: temporary credit hold and invoice realignment for Orion Health
messages:
From: Samantha Brook <samantha.brook@orionhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Patel <devon.patel@orionhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-24T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary credit hold and invoice realignment

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We're moving toward production but our finance team is asking for an interim arrangement while our controller finalizes a treasury re-org. Can Redwood temporarily hold collection of overdue amounts from our March invoice and realign the upcoming invoices to a quarterly milestone schedule (invoice at completion of each quarter rather than monthly)?

Concretely: we request a one-time credit hold on the outstanding $145,200, and thereafter invoicing on a quarterly cadence with Net-90 terms for the first two quarters while we finish our cash reforecast. We understand this is non-standard — happy to provide a short-term guarantee or take a purchase order number. Please let me know what information you need to escalate.

Regards,
Samantha Brook
Head of Finance, Orion Health
attachments: Orion_Q1-credit_summary.pdf (pdf)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Brook <samantha.brook@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-24T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary credit hold and invoice realignment

Samantha —

Appreciate the transparency. I can escalate this to Deal Desk + Finance for exception review. A few quick asks so we have the right package for exec signoff:

- Confirm PO number or written acknowledgement that Orion will prioritize collection once the treasury re-org completes.
- Any internal date target for returning to standard monthly terms? If not, we should limit the Net-90 request to two quarters.
- Can you provide the accounts payable contact and ACH details if we require pre-authorization?

I'll loop in Jon and Karthik to weigh in on risk and pricing. If we can get a short guarantee or pre-signed MOP we can consider a conditional Net-90 and a one-time deferral.

I'll escalate this afternoon with an ask for Marcus to sign off on the exception if Finance signs the mitigation.

Thanks,
Monica
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Brook <samantha.brook@orionhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-24T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: temporary credit hold and invoice realignment

Folks —

From Sales Ops perspective: if we accept Net-90 for two quarters + a one-time credit hold, we should capture the following in the deviation record:

- Exact outstanding amount being deferred: $145,200
- Maximum exposure cap (recommend: $175k to cover churn/misc fees)
- Collateral/guarantee: signed MOP or PO with billing schedule
- Price protection: no additional discount unless approved by RevOps

I've attached a proposed invoicing schedule that maps quarter boundaries to deliverables. If legal wants to add a specific collection clause we can template it quickly.

attachments: proposed_invoicing_schedule.xlsx

Jonas
Sales Operations
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Brook <samantha.brook@orionhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T08:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary credit hold and invoice realignment

Monica / Team —

Finance is prepared to recommend a conditional approval if Orion provides two items:

1) A signed MOP (method of payment) authorization or PO covering the outstanding amount, and
2) ACH pre-authorization on file for future quarterly invoices, or a corporate guarantee from an Orion subsidiary.

We will also require a 2% processing fee to cover extended collection risk (can be applied to payment schedule). If Orion declines these mitigations, Finance will not sign off.

Karthik
Head of Finance Operations
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Samantha Brook <samantha.brook@orionhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary credit hold and invoice realignment (need exec signoff)

Marcus —

Looping you in for a quick executive exception approval. Summary:

- Customer: Orion Health (strategic, potential expansion in product lines)
- Request: One-time credit hold on $145,200 (March invoice) + move to quarterly invoicing on Net-90 for two quarters.
- Finance conditions: signed MOP/PO for outstanding balance, ACH pre-auth or corporate guarantee, and 2% extended-risk fee.
- Sales Ops recommends exposure cap at $175k and no concessions to list price.

If you can approve the conditional exception (Net-90 x2 quarters + credit hold contingent on items above), we will send a deviation letter and updated SOW addendum for signature. If you prefer tighter limits we can require a partial upfront payment (25%) before granting the deferment.

Thanks for a quick read — Orion needs our response by EOD Friday to avoid disruption to procurement cadence.

—Monica
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Brook <samantha.brook@orionhealth.com>, Devon Patel <devon.patel@orionhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-30T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary credit hold and invoice realignment (need exec signoff)

Thanks team — reviewed. Approve the conditional exception with these hard limits:

1) One-time credit hold on outstanding $145,200 for 60 days from sign-off; if not paid within 60 days, full balance becomes due immediately.
2) Invoicing cadence: quarterly invoicing for two quarters only, Net-90 terms.
3) Required customer deliverables before deferment effective: signed MOP/PO covering outstanding amount, ACH pre-authorization for future invoices, and a corporate guarantee or evidence of treasury re-org timeline.
4) Processing fee: 2% applied to deferred balance; no additional discounts.
5) Exposure cap: $175,000.

Monica — please issue a deviation letter and updated SOW addendum reflecting these conditions. Finance (Karthik) will verify the MOP/PO and confirm ACH prior to the first deferred invoice. Jon, please prepare the billing schedule doc for signatures.

Marcus Lin
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: signed-mop-agreement.docx
